objects.name: Transparent Tribe
objects.description: [Transparent Tribe](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0134) is a suspected Pakistan-based threat group that has been active since at least 2013, primarily targeting diplomatic, defense, and research organizations in India and Afghanistan.(Citation: Proofpoint Operation Transparent Tribe March 2016)(Citation: Kaspersky Transparent Tribe August 2020)(Citation: Talos Transparent Tribe May 2021)

objects.description_fa: [Transparent Tribe](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0134) یک گروه تهدید مشکوک مستقر در پاکستان است که حداقل از سال 2013 فعال بوده است و عمدتاً سازمان‌های دیپلماتیک، دفاعی و تحقیقاتی را در هند و افغانستان هدف قرار می‌دهد. (Citation: Proofpoint Operation Transparent Tribe March 2016) (Citation: Kaspersky Transparent Tribe August 2020) (Citation: Talos Transparent Tribe May 2021)
